title: No test holds the headings the skills read with selfdoc.py section
goal: A test runs every selfdoc.py section command named in .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md and fails when one exits non-zero or its text holds a character Bash and PowerShell read differently (a backslash-escaped backtick, $(, a backtick), so renaming a heading a skill reads, or a command that parses in one shell only, fails the gate
notes: SP-qdq57zu3 retrospective: the kb-ingest section command escaped backticks and did not parse under PowerShell (BG-v2xwgr6m); no test parses the skills' commands for both shells.
